notes.title: Update [version 1.2]
notes.content:
Update for [b]Me && MORY[/b]
(GB04242024)

[list]
[*]Bluetooth controllers support.*
[*]Minor changes to game controls.**
[*]Add a menu to the Preferences.***
[/list]
*: most Bluetooth controllers are compatible (with a few exceptions, such as Dual Sense).

**: with a controller, the "Start" button now opens the game menu.

***: It is now possible to redefine certain buttons on the controller for the main actions.

Thanks for your support!

P.S.: a new wallpaper is available in the game folder.

notes.title: Update [version 1.1]
notes.content:
Update for [b]Me && MORY[/b]
(GB12072023)

[list]
[*]Steam achievement bug fixed.*
[/list]
* : Previously, if you achieved a higher score in a level,
it didn't count towards a certain achievement. This was a bug!
Now it's fixed.


If you've completed the game and achieved your high scores,
load your save, and simply complete a level.

The achievement will be unlocked.

Thanks for your support & special thanks to [b]nana[/b]!

notes.title: Me && MORY is available + additional info!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you already know, [b]Me && MORY[/b] is available.

Thank you for your interest in this new game.

It takes place before [b]LAMBDA end THEORY[/b], and represents a first beginning of the story.
However, [b]Me && MORY[/b] is also very cryptic and many elements are,
like the following game, open to interpretation.

In order to facilitate the understanding and to bring a chronology, all [b]PIXLEAVES[/b] games
will be represented under the name of [b]DATA + STARS Saga[/b].

[h2]DATA + STARS Saga[/h2]

[b]DATA + STARS Saga[/b] is, as its name suggests, a saga of Data and Stars stories,
divided into several volumes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43590100/61d6a15b9d69ac96227441b8cd1f41d00992a60a.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32280/DATA__STARS_Saga__Volume_1/]Volume 1[/url] is completed. It includes the following games:
[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272640/Me__MORY/]Me && MORY[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1908570/LAMBDA_end_THEORY/]LAMBDA end THEORY[/url][/list]
Thus, you can acquire them in bundle or separately.

In this regard, note that the soundtracks of the games are also available on [b]Steam[/b].

[h2]Future and Volume 2[/h2]

Naturally, work on [b]Volume 2[/b] will begin this year to continue the story.
The next games will be in a different tone and will propose an evolution.
I can't wait to introduce them to you!

Thank you very much for your support!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43590100/68c6ec076171b876d7bf8da9356f0cecf02bc978.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43590100/189d248160c7a80a1a0d3479fc2f6681a7910fdc.jpg[/img][/url]
